main_text.p: forum gurgitibus versantes ad precandū hortatur. verf.1.
2. Ut autem non nisi ad Iehovam clamat, sic de exauditione plenè persuasa est. verf.2.
3. Agnoscit autem illa, adversa quibus exercentur fideles, esse θεόπνευστα[?]: nec hominibus, aut alijs propinquis afflictionū caufsis, irafcendum esse. verf.3.
4. Ut autem cum desperationis tenta-tione vehementer luctatur fides: sic eam tandem fortiter insurgens superat. verf.4.
5. Nec sane ita leuiter afficitur afflictionum magnitudine, multitudine, & earū acerbissimo sensu, quin infirma caro querulas hominis voces extorqueat. verf.5.

6. A' desperationis tamen praecipitio mœstum hominis animū fides serena, Sol lis instar exoriens & emergens, & confolationis radijs caliginem discutiens, revocat, & praeclarè de liberatione divina sperare iubet. verf.6.
7. Iubet etiam fides, ut non tam in no-stra mala, quorum sensus acerbissimus est, quam in Iohovam omnipotentem & beneficum respiciamus, plenè de precū exauditione persuasi. verf.7.

page.notes: The Greek word after "esse" is only partly legible; θεόπνευστα is a best reading and marked [?]. "A'" in verse 6 is printed with a mark I could not resolve. "querulas" is a reading across a line break ("que / rulas"). The signature "I 2" is faint. Tall s is rendered as plain s throughout; u/v and i/j changed by function as instructed.
